title: 2024 Upper Deck #19 Tiger Woods United States Golf Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: The 2024 Upper Deck Golf #19 Tiger Woods PGA Tour trading card is a standard-sized single featuring the legendary golfer Tiger Woods. Manufactured by Upper Deck, this card is part of the base set for the 2024 season of the PGA Tour. Made of card stock and in English language, this sports trading card celebrates Tiger Woods and his achievements in the sport of golf. With no autograph and not considered vintage, this card is a must-have for fans of the US golfer and collectors of modern sports trading cards.
